caption: The image shows a wooden chest or trunk with a rectangular shape and raised on four low, curved feet. The chest is primarily brown, with various decorative elements in lighter and gold tones. The front panel features ornate floral designs with a central bouquet in a vase, two large flowers on either side, and scrolling lines that frame the artwork. The text "MARIA KUTZ" and "1783" is inscribed among the designs, likely indicating a name and a date. The base of the chest has three rectangular drawers, each with a gold-colored handle; the drawers are bordered with thin, gold-toned lines. The sides of the chest display smaller floral and ornamented patterns, with an arched decorative border above them. The wood grain texture is visible throughout the chest, and the piece is drawn against a plain, off-white background with the illustrator's name, Frances Lichten, in small letters to the left of the chest.
title: Chest
